extensionDescription.message: Region, full-page, and scrolling screenshots with local annotation tools.

longHint.message: Lock the start, then extend the lower edge

shortcutHint.message: Focus the field and press a new key combination. Default: Alt+Shift+A. If Firefox, the OS, or another extension still owns it, choose another combination.

shortcutClearedHint.message: Shortcut cleared. Click Save to disable it.

invalidShortcut.message: That key cannot be used as an extension shortcut.

shortcutNeedsModifier.message: Letter and number shortcuts need Ctrl, Alt, or Command.

shortcutReady.message: Shortcut recorded. Click Save to apply it.

shortcutSaved.message: Shortcut saved. If another extension still fires, choose another combination.

shortcutConflict.message: Firefox did not register this shortcut, or the combination may be occupied. Choose another combination and save it.

shortcutManagerUnavailable.message: Could not open Firefox shortcut settings.
